reasons.plausibility: Oxide dispersion strengthening with Y2O3 is a scientifically robust strategy used in high-temperature alloys and small additions can effectively improve creep strength while minimally altering other properties.
reasons.testability: Comparing mechanical and density measurements for baseline and Y2O3-added alloys at both high and room temperatures is a clear and feasible approach.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses the question of enhancing high-temperature performance without sacrificing lightweight and room-temperature properties, making it highly relevant for jet-turbine applications.
